title: STRENGTH
FOR THE ROAD
end: The Midday Watch — pause and pray at noon
stock_queries: bright midday sun shining through tall window onto empty wooden desk
golden afternoon light over dry valley landscape and distant hills
clear spring water filling a stone basin in bright daylight
sunlit mountain trail ascending upward into bright open sky
quiet ancient stone wall bathed in warm midday sunlight
peaceful high noon wilderness landscape with soft natural light
strong stone fortress wall standing firm under bright midday sun

scenes.a: That looming decision on your desk is testing the very limits of your endurance.
Lord, when the road ahead feels dry and weary, let your presence be our inner resolve.
Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.
Transform every dry and difficult place we must walk through today.
Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
Father, lead us onward through every trial by your unfailing grace.
They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.
